title: Correct fall time
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the time to fall as 4 s using free-fall kinematics.

title: Correct landing velocity
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the magnitude of the landing velocity as 40 m/s.

title: Correct last-second displacement
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the displacement in the last second as 35 m.

title: Proper kinematic reasoning
description: Important: The solution should apply correct free-fall equations (e.g., h = ½gt², v = gt) or equivalent energy methods.

title: Last-second method
description: Important: For part (3), the solution should correctly find displacement by subtracting distance fallen in first 3 seconds from total height.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Using incorrect sign for acceleration due to gravity or confusing displacement with distance.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Including proper units (s, m/s, m) in final answers and showing unit analysis in steps.
